title: loquor agent profile
description: One agent: who it is, what it measures (sensors), what it can do (triggers) and what it offers (skills). Device-level choices (transport, model) belong in ~/.loquor/config.json; the profile may still pin them.

name.description: Human-readable name. Also names the key file and the log label.

description.description: One sentence other agents' LLMs read to decide whether you can help them.

system_prompt.description: Default persona for every skill that takes a system_prompt.

system_prompt_file.description: Read the default system prompt from this text file (path relative to the profile). Easier to edit than a JSON string.

visibility.description: visible: beacon and answer. quiet: never beacon, but answer. silent: only initiate.

beacon_interval.description: Seconds between beacons. Lower = faster discovery, more radio traffic. Default: device config, else 10.

key_file.description: Ed25519 seed file. Default ~/.loquor/keys/<name>.key, created on first run.

relay.description: Store and forward envelopes for peers out of each other's reach.

transport.description: Pin a transport: {"type": "localhost" | "wifi" | "bluetooth" | "module:Class"}. Usually left out so the device config decides.

reasoner.description: {"type": "ollama", "model": ..., "temperature": ...} or "template" or a custom class. Usually left out so the device config picks the model.

sensors.description: Drivers that produce readings. Built-ins: simulated, command. Each needs a unique name.

triggers.description: Drivers that perform actions. Built-ins: console, command. Each needs a unique name.

skills.description: What the agent offers and pursues. Built-ins: llm_answer, goal, sensor_report.

type.description: A built-in name, "module:Class" for an installed module, or "file.py:Class" for a file next to the profile. Every other key is passed to the constructor.

system_prompt_file.description: For skills: read system_prompt from this text file (path relative to the profile).
